data.name: Elwin
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German name Aluwih, which consists of two parts: 'al' meaning ‘other’ or ‘all’ and ‘win’ meaning ‘friend’ or ‘kin’. It was common among the Germanic peoples and was brought to England by the early Anglo-Saxon settlers. The name Elwin can be interpreted as 'elf-friend' or 'friend of all'.
